# The immediate updatebot backout restores the no-lint argument and prior file blob

The immediate backout restores --no-lint in the sole submit argument edit and reverses both complete file blobs from the preceding follow-up. Accepted source later omits that flag again, so the backout is a separate phase rather than the final command policy. Reused actual run_cmd/source objects keep their original identities. No external lint default, backout cause or successful submission was established.

Scope: Updatebot moz-phab submit immediate backout.
